description: Ministry of Public Administration and Local Government Home Affairs Provincial Council - Declare that the term of Office of the National Delimitation Committee on Demarcation of wards for Local Authorities Consisting of the members appointed w.e.f. 01/11/2022 up to 28.02.2023 is extended up to 31.03.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is about the extension of the term of office for the National Delimitation Committee on Demarcation of Wards for Local Authorities. This falls under electoral processes and specifically involves electoral boundary changes, which is the primary focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). While it mentions the Prime Minister's name and portfolio, this is incidental to the main electoral content and does not constitute a government personnel change or detailed portfolio assignment that would require classification under Types 1-3.
